name: NSE: A Generic Ghost Story
source:
When three friends stumble upon an unknown mansion, they decide it’s the perfect place for a Halloween party. 

Surely nothing will go wrong…

[From [url=https://anmarisinkman.itch.io/nse-a-generic-ghost-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三个朋友偶然发现了一座来历不明的宅邸，一致认定在这里办万圣节派对再合适不过。

肯定不会出什么岔子吧…
